# 02 Unify the direction vocabulary

## Outcome

One direction type in the codebase. `ClassDirection` and `RankDirection` are gone, both mapping
tables with them, and `direction TD` works in a class diagram for the same reason `flowchart TD`
works in a flowchart: it is one alias rule, owned once.

## Why this ticket exists

After ticket 01, `Direction`, `ClassDirection` and `RankDirection` have identical value sets and
are bridged by two hand-written tables. `layoutClassDiagram.ts` justifies the split as
"`ClassDirection` is a pipeline contract, `RankDirection` is the core's own" — but
`layoutDirectedGraph` already imports `Point` from `contracts`, so the isolation that argument
depends on is not actually there. A seam with two adapters that both map identity is not a seam;
it is two chances to write the table down wrong.

The author-visible half is `direction TD` in a class diagram, which `DIRECTION_RE` currently
rejects. That is the same alias ticket 01 taught the flowchart header, and after this ticket it is
the same rule rather than a second copy of it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `classDiagram` + `direction TD` parses and resolves to `TB`; the other four spellings are
  unchanged.
- [x] `ClassDirection` is deleted from `contracts.ts`; every declaration that used it uses
  `Direction`.
- [x] `RankDirection` is deleted from `layoutDirectedGraph.ts`; `rankdir` takes `Direction`,
  imported from `contracts`.
- [x] `RANK_DIRECTION` in `layoutClassDiagram.ts` is deleted and `model.direction` is passed
  straight through.
- [~] ~~The class-diagram direction diagnostic names the accepted spellings, including `TD`.~~
  **Dropped during implementation**: there is no dedicated direction diagnostic to reword. A bad
  `direction FOO` falls through to `Unrecognized classDiagram line: "direction FOO"`, which is a
  reasonable message. Adding a direction-specific diagnostic would be a new feature, not
  vocabulary unification.
- [x] `grep -rn "ClassDirection\|RankDirection" packages/` returns nothing.
- [x] No layout coordinate changes for any existing class-diagram or flowchart test — this ticket
  moves vocabulary, not geometry. A moved coordinate is a signal something else changed.

## Test seam

`render()` for the `direction TD` behavior; the existing `layoutClassDiagram` and
`layoutDirectedGraph` suites stand as the regression net for the type collapse. Do not add tests
that assert the *type* — assert the behavior and let `tsc --noEmit` police the type.

## Deviation from the plan

The ticket promised "one alias rule, owned once". Satisfying the failing test needed only a second
copy of `TD ? TB` inside `parseClassDiagram` — which is exactly the drift this board exists to
stop, and would have left the ticket's own Why unmet. So the rule was lifted into a new
`parser/parseDirection.ts` (`DIRECTION_ALTERNATION` + `normalizeDirection`) and all three
accepting sites now build their regex from it: the two `flowchart` headers and the class diagram's
`direction` statement.

That grew write ownership by three files beyond what the plan listed. Safe here because the board
is sequential and no other worker holds them; recorded rather than done silently.
